package rulefixtures

import (
	"net/http"

	"github.com/gin-gonic/gin"
)

// scenario for loadhtmlglob_or_loadhtmlfiles_in_request_path: LoadHTMLGlob or LoadHTMLFiles called on request paths instead of startup initialization.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: gin; severity: contextual.
func scenario323Positive(c *gin.Context) {
	engine := gin.New()
	engine.LoadHTMLGlob("templates/*")
	c.HTML(http.StatusOK, "index.tmpl", nil)
}
